args: for cmd in graphify-mcp "$HOME/.local/bin/graphify-mcp" "$HOME/Library/Python/3.12/bin/graphify-mcp" "$HOME/Library/Python/3.11/bin/graphify-mcp" /opt/homebrew/bin/graphify-mcp; do if command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$cmd" --graph graphify-out/graph.json; fi; done; for py in python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3; do if command -v "$py" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$py" -c 'import graphify.serve' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$py" -m graphify.serve graphify-out/graph.json; fi; done; echo 'graphify is not installed. Run: pipx install graphifyy or uv tool install graphifyy' >&2; exit 1
